title: Resolve Java var types for jOOQ table new-record factories
wanted_capability: Authoritative Java var type resolution for jOOQ Table<R>.newRecord() (and generic static-factory) patterns via the JDTLS-backed seam (analysis.resolveVarTypes / lsp.typeAt over a harness-owned JDTLS session). JDTLS resolves the generic parameter R that facts heuristics and the name-level index cannot.
missing_primitive: jdtls-seam: bro-lsp Language::Java (JDTLS session pool) + a new lsp.typeAt/lsp.hover harness binding verb + an analysis.resolveVarTypes({file, spans}) reduction that calls the pool
fallback_used: Probe agent inferred the record type manually after compile exposed an incorrect helper parameter type, then patched the helper signature.
notes:
REFRAMED (2026-06-18) to the JDTLS-backed implementation path. Original framing ("methodRegions should provide resolved_type for jOOQ table new-record factories") is doubly blocked: (1) the facts module (scope.rs/resolve_var_declaration_type) is pure-bytes by charter — no LSP, no cross-file; (2) the jOOQ case needs generic-parameter inference (Table<R extends Record>.newRecord() returns R), which neither facts heuristics nor a name-level corpus index can resolve. The shipped static-factory heuristic (is_known_static_factory_method, scope.rs:713) only matches of/from/valueOf/copyOf/getInstance/newInstance and returns the RECEIVER type (a TableImpl), not R.

Solve = the same JDTLS seam as gap-f9db476b: bro-lsp Language::Java + lsp.typeAt/lsp.hover + analysis.resolveVarTypes. JDTLS resolves the generic parameter R definitively (it is a full Java compiler frontend), so Table<R>.newRecord() yields the concrete record type. This is the one solve that covers both jOOQ generics and cross-file receiver calls in a single stroke.

Supersedes the index-backed recommendation in thread-8d968b2d Note 26 (index cannot resolve generics; unreachable from cells per af3c4783). Pair with gap-f9db476b — they share one seam and should be delivered together.
